summary: EnerSys filed an 8-K on May 20, 2026, to furnish an earnings press release for Q4 fiscal 2026 and announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.2625 per share, payable July 2, 2026, to holders of record June 19, 2026. The filing reports record full-year net sales of $3.75B, diluted EPS of $7.70, and adjusted diluted EPS of $10.56. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration; no special situation such as M&A, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. The company continues its regular capital return program with buybacks and dividends.
